title: Sanjay Rai @ Chintu Rai v. State of U.P. and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta and Syed Qamar Hasan Rizvi, JJ.
disposition: Petition disposed; withdrawn recovery to be redone under Supply Code.
headnote: Recovery certificate for alleged theft dues withdrawn by the electricity department. Petition disposed of with liberty to pass a fresh order after hearing, strictly in accordance with the procedure under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Sanjay Rai, also known as Chintu Rai, petitioned the Allahabad High Court against a recovery certificate dated 23 July 2021 issued by respondent no. 4. The certificate sought electricity dues alleged to arise from theft of electricity. The electricity department first took time, on 9 February 2023, to obtain instructions, and on 15 February 2023 was allowed two further days. On 17 February 2023 its counsel stated that the impugned recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after the petitioner was given a hearing.

holding_units.topic: theft-dues recovery withdrawn; fresh order under Supply Code procedure
holding_units.holding: Where the licensee withdraws the impugned recovery certificate for alleged theft dues and states that a fresh order will be passed after hearing the consumer, the writ is disposed of with liberty to pass that order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: no numbered clause cited; order refers only to the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005

principle_tags.application: After the department withdrew the theft-dues recovery certificate and undertook to hear the consumer, the Court disposed of the writ and left the respondents to pass a fresh order strictly under the procedure in the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, without deciding the dues.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner had committed theft of electricity and what dues, if any, are recoverable.
not_decided.note: Left to a fresh order after hearing, strictly under the procedure in the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
